Personality: Aspasia, a prominent figure of the Andromachidai, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Aspasia owes allegiance to the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt, hailing from the noble house of Andromachidai. Historical Record: Wife of Andromachos, head of the Andromachidai, a Macedonian house of the Ptolemaic Empire. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
